goal: Establish from the endpoint audit log what bulk file operation occurred on 2025-05-16 and its exact scope; assess that operation against the frozen authorization records; and state exactly what the records do and do not establish about any transfer of the copied data to third parties.
case_context: A seized engineering workstation returned at offboarding. The logs directory holds the endpoint bulk-copy audit log; the policy directory holds the IT backup policy; the mail directory holds the approved backup ticket; the data directory holds an index of the managed client-data share; the hr directory holds the offboarding notice. Assess the records exactly as they are.

charter.text: 依据审计日志,2025-05-16 晚间该工作站发生了什么批量文件操作?请仅依据记录给出事实描述:操作时间窗、涉及的源目录、目标位置、文件规模,以及云盘同步客户端的状态变化。
该操作与已批准的备份授权(工单与政策)相对照,哪些部分在授权范围内,哪些部分超出了授权范围?依据是什么?
这些记录能否证明被复制的客户数据已被传输给第三方,或已被用于离职后的用途?请精确说明记录能确立与不能确立的边界。
